messages:
sam: Heads up  /v1/embeddings (us-west) p95 up ~80ms at 04:10 UTC, p50 flat. Spike lines up with a routing weight change earlier today? Anyone on duty see correlated increases in queue_time? :mag:
marta: I saw the same on the per-endpoint page. Strange that p99 hardly moved but p95 did. Could be a redistribution where a subset of requests hit a slower path.
devon: We added a new multiplexed connector for small payloads last deploy. If some requests are routed to the connector with occasional GC or backpressure, that would inflate the mid-tail. We need to split telemetry by connector variant.
sam: Agreed. Can the console show endpoint breakdown by routing tag (connector_id/model_variant) and sample_count inline? Right now it's just a flat p95 value which hides heterogeneity.
lia: UX caution: too many breakdown dimensions will overwhelm the UI. Propose a collapsed "Breakdown" pill that expands to a small table: variant | p50 | p95 | sample_count | provenance. Default to hide zero-count variants. Also include a tiny sparkline for sample_count so people can spot sparse data.
metrics-bot: metrics: rollup job for latency TDigest updated at 2024-11-08T04:05Z. Available metrics: latency_p50, latency_p95, latency_p99, latency_histogram, sample_count.
devon: Backend ask: tag ingresses with `connector_id` and `timing_origin` (service vs end2end). We'll emit tdigest per (endpoint,connector,1m). That gives us cheap per-variant percentiles without scanning raw events.
sam: For console: two features to prioritize: 1) show sample_count badge next to percentile, 2) a small "percentile confidence" hint (low sample_count => wide CI). We can compute CI from tdigest bootstrap approximations, or approximate using Poisson bootstrap on counts.
lia: UX copy: show CI as ±ms with a little tooltip: "95% confidence interval estimated from sample distribution. Narrow intervals indicate high confidence." Keep it subtle. Don't show CI if sample_count < 50.
devon: Ops note: also add an alert rule suggestion: "p95 increase > 30% AND sample_count >= 500 AND variant_sample_fraction >= 0.05". That avoids noisy alerts from tiny cohorts. I can add a helper in the alerts service to compute `variant_sample_fraction`.
sam: One more: add an API param for the metrics endpoint to return per-variant percentiles: `GET /metrics/query?endpoint=/v1/embeddings&group_by=connector_id&metrics=p95,p50&window=5m&meta=true`. Response includes sample_count+confidence. UI can fetch that on demand when user expands the breakdown pill.
marta: Nice. Action items: devon to emit tdigest per connector & timing_origin + update rollup. sam to draft API spec for group_by+meta. lia to design breakdown pill + CI badge. We'll test in staging next deploy and gate via a feature flag. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
